channel.description: Latest articles from Treasury Today Group (treasurytoday.com)

item.title: Press release: Etiqa Insurance Singapore and AIA Singapore join forces to expand accessibility of Takaful for customers | Treasury Today
item.description: 24th March 2026 – Etiqa Insurance Singaporeand AIA Singapore today announced a strategic distribution partnership to broaden access to Shariah-compliant, values-based Takaful solutions across Singapore.

item.title: Press release: How sustainability drives reinvention – 2025 PwC China Sustainability Report | Treasury Today
item.description: 24th March 2026 – The 2025 PwC China Sustainability Report is released today. The report provides a detailed picture of how our work impacts the environment, people and society, while looking back on a year of rapid technological advances, increasing climate concerns and complex geopolitical changes.

item.title: Press release: Cathay Pacific expands global partnership with Adyen | Treasury Today
item.description: 23rd March 2026 – Adyen, the global financial technology platform of choice for leading businesses, today announced the expansion of its longstanding partnership with Cathay Pacific, Hong Kong’s home airline.

item.title: Press release: C2FO hits milestone providing working capital to businesses worldwide | Treasury Today
item.description: 18th March 2026 – C2FO announced today it has funded more than half a trillion dollars in working capital to businesses worldwide.

item.title: Press release: Corporate treasurers move in lockstep as Fed policy pause squeezes return gap | Treasury Today
item.description: 19th March 2026 – Corporate treasurers are increasingly earning the same returns on their cash piles, a sign that the Federal Reserve’s slower and more predictable policy cycle is reshaping how companies manage billions of dollars in short term investments.

item.title: Press release: BACB announces strong FY2025 results with growth across frontier markets | Treasury Today
item.description: 16th March 2026 – British Arab Commercial Bank (BACB), the London-based specialist trade finance bank, has announced its financial results for the year ended 31 December 2025, reporting strong performance following last year’s set of record results.

item.title: Press release: Afreximbank and FCI to host Africa Regional Conference on Factoring, Receivables Finance & Credit Insurance in Kampala | Treasury Today
item.description: 23rd March 2026 – African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) (www.Afreximbank.com) and FCI will jointly host the Africa Regional Conference on Factoring, Receivables Finance & Credit Insurance on 15–16 April 2026 in Kampala, Uganda.

item.title: Press release: J.P. Morgan Payments helps Wizz Air manage currency risk | Treasury Today
item.description: 16th March 2026 – Wizz Air Group, a Hungarian ultra-low-cost carrier listed on the FTSE 250 index, has implemented J.P. Morgan Payments’ virtual netting solution, becoming the first client to deploy the capability to streamline intercompany settlement and better manage foreign exchange (FX) exposure across its global operations.

item.title: Press release: Euronext successfully launches Euronext Nord Pool Power Futures market | Treasury Today
item.description: 19th March 2026 – Euronext, the leading European capital market infrastructure, announces the successful launch of Euronext Nord Pool Power Futures in the Nordics and Baltics.

item.title: Press release: EU to delay FRTB regulation amid ‘concerns’ over EU bank competitiveness | Treasury Today
item.description: 19th March 2026 – The European Commission is set to delay the impact of the Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB) in a bid to stop EU lenders from being put at a disadvantage by US moves to cut capital requirements for big banks.
